questions.question: How should BK-397 move forward, given the logs are accumulating but no reader exists?

options.label: Build step 2 now (Recommended)
options.description: Add the trace `decisions:` key and the check_traces.py rule with failing fixtures first. Step 3 and the two-branch fix follow in later PRs; the three-delivery count starts once both readers exist.

options.label: Build steps 2 and 3 together
options.description: One larger PR adds the schema key, the check, the PR template section and the /pr rendering. Acceptance counting starts sooner, but the review is bigger and step 3's unpriming question has to be settled in it.

options.label: Amend acceptance
options.description: Change the RFC so the existing logs count as evidence, and graduate on that. This is quicker, but it drops the proof that readers turn the logs into a trace and PR record, which is the RFC's stated point.

options.label: Leave as is
options.description: No change now. The item stays [~] and the logs keep accumulating.

questions.question: Step 2 is done but not committed yet. How should it ship?

options.label: Commit and open a PR (Recommended)
options.description: One BK-397 commit on a properly named branch (bk-397-trace-decisions-key), then /pr runs the gates and opens the PR. Its review block goes into the trace at the close.

options.label: Commit only
options.description: Commit locally on worktree-BK-397 and stop. You push and open the PR yourself.

options.label: Leave uncommitted
options.description: Nothing is committed, so you can review the diff first. This session's decision log stays untracked until the next agent commit.

options.label: Drop the CLAUDE.md edit, then PR
options.description: Same as the first option, but without the CLAUDE.md line, which loads into every session. The CLAUDE-REFERENCE row and the schema stay the only pointers.

questions.question: PR #1091's branch is 1 commit behind origin/master. Rebase before fixing?

options.label: Rebase and force-push (Recommended)
options.description: Commit the decision-log tail, rebase onto origin/master, push with --force-with-lease, then fetch comments against the new head. Step 6's push is then a plain fast-forward.

options.label: Fix without rebasing
options.description: Leave the branch behind master and fix on the current head. No force-push; the base commit stays unmerged into the branch until merge time.

questions.question: When a listed log has a malformed line or a dialog answered twice, what should the author be allowed to do to get check_traces green?

options.label: Repair the line (Recommended)
options.description: The log stays append-only for the recorder, but a line that is not a record (a truncated tail, an identical copy left by a union merge) may be deleted in its own commit naming the line and its cause. Two answered events that differ are not an artifact: they stay a failure for the maintainer to decide. Keeps RFC-0018 D4.2's failures as written.

options.label: Demote to notes
options.description: Only a missing log fails; malformed lines and double answers become notes. The log is never edited and the gate never blocks on its content, but this departs from D4.2's text, so the RFC is amended in this PR.

options.label: Fail, plus a register
options.description: Keep failing and never edit the log; add a tolerated-divergence register (owner and rationale per defective log line) that the gate reads to accept known defects. Most faithful to append-only, and the heaviest to build.

questions.question: Two answered events for one dialog with different answers: may the maintainer delete one to get the gate green?

options.label: Yes, amend D2 to say so (Recommended)
options.description: D2's exception names a third case: a differing second answer, where the maintainer picks the record and the deleting commit says which and why. The schema stays as is, and the RFC Status names all three cases. Every failure then has a remedy.

options.label: No, never delete it
options.description: Narrow the schema to D2's two cases. A differing double answer stays a hard failure with no in-repo fix except de-listing the log, the gap the first review raised.

options.label: No, demote it to a note
options.description: Keep D2's two cases and make a differing double answer a note, not a failure. Nothing is deleted and the gate goes green, but D4.2's 'no tool_use_id answered twice' becomes a report for this case, so D4.2 is amended.
